plugins.name: neomjs
plugins.description: Build data grids, Gantt charts, schedulers, kanban boards and multi-window web desktops with Neo.mjs, which runs components, stores and state in workers, off the main thread. Includes the Neural Link workflow: inspect and patch a running app's live component tree, stores and DOM instead of reloading and screenshotting.
